kpmee01.title: Sent Before Thinking
kpmee01.caption:
One coffee, 0.2 seconds, one very bold text. Even Mercury had to rewind.
Aries, what's the fastest you've ever hit send?

kpmee02.title: The Three-Day Reply
kpmee02.caption:
Wanting your reply to be perfect is sweet. Three days of silence just feels like silence.
A short honest answer now beats a perfect one later. Save this for the next sweet text.

kpmee03.title: Two Chats, One Feeling
kpmee03.caption:
Gemini answered 39 chats in a minute and dodged exactly one. Guess which.
Mercury has notes, a retrograde alibi and one very slow text. Who's your one chat?

kpmee04.title: The Paragraph You Didn't Send
kpmee04.caption:
When someone goes quiet, the check-in you write can turn into nine pages of love.
Lead with the feeling and keep one ask. The rest can wait for Sunday.

kpmee05.title: Refreshing the Viewer List
kpmee05.caption:
Refresh number 43 and they finally viewed it. Mercury would like a word.
Leo, how many stories have you posted for one person?

kpmee06.title: The Overthinker's Debrief
kpmee06.caption:
2 a.m., replaying the one moment you're sure you ruined. Wait for what they actually texted.
Sort what happened from what you're guessing, then ask. Sleep comes easier after.

kpmee07.title: Typing, Stopped, Typing
kpmee07.caption:
Forty minutes of typing dots and Pisces on the other end, spiralling.
The coin didn't decide anything. Libra's face did. Heads or tails, what's yours?

kpmee08.title: Fine Is Not a Feeling
kpmee08.caption:
"Fine." can carry a lot: disappointed, missing them, not wanting to seem needy.
Name it without blame and leave the door open. A short true text lands softer than you think.

kpmee09.title: Forty-Two Unreads
kpmee09.caption:
Two weeks offline, forty-two unreads and one very worried voice note.
No essay needed. Sagittarius, who's waiting on your reply right now?

kpmee10.title: You Sent Your Crush an Agenda
kpmee10.caption:
Clear plans are a kindness. Texting your crush like a calendar invite is a choice.
Keep the plan, add why you want to go. Saturday sounds better with a little heart in it.

kpmee11.title: Facts, Not Feelings
kpmee11.caption:
They asked "do you like me?" and got a fact about octopuses. True fact, wrong answer.
Aquarius, what's your go-to dodge?

kpmee12.title: Six Sorrys
kpmee12.caption:
Five minutes late and six sorrys deep. Pisces, they were happy to wait.
One sorry, then a thank-you. It tells people they matter without you shrinking.
